Main.Tagline: Control app and browser-tab audio independently
Main.RestoreAllTip: Restore volume, mute, balance, output device, and effects

Settings.LanguageDescription: Changes the interface immediately without restarting audio control.
Settings.StartupDescription: Choose when the application appears and what happens when its window closes.
Settings.StartWithWindows: Start after signing in to Windows
Settings.StartInTray: Remain in the notification area after startup
Settings.CloseToTray: Keep running in the notification area when the window closes
Settings.SessionDescription: Control the source list and what is restored next time.
Settings.HideBrowserAggregate: Hide aggregate browser sessions while tab enhancement is active
Settings.HideBrowserAggregateTip: Chrome and Edge are evaluated separately; only duplicate Windows sessions are hidden and audio is unchanged
Settings.BrowserDescription: Control each tab with up to 200% volume, EQ, and an independent output device.
Settings.ScrollDescription: The source list uses smooth pixel scrolling; an unfocused slider cannot be changed accidentally by the mouse wheel.
Settings.TechnicalDescription: Standard apps use native Windows volume, mute, balance, and output policy. Browser enhancement processes only a tab that you explicitly enable. Exiting restores changes made during this run.
Browser.WelcomeDescription: Standard Windows app controls are ready to use. Browser enhancement is optional and lets you control Chrome and Edge tabs separately.
Browser.ConnectionDescription: Connected appears only after the desktop application receives a message from the extension.
Browser.LocalInstallDescription: The extension is not yet published in a browser store, so you must load it once. The application never changes browser configuration or simulates security confirmation clicks.
Browser.Step1: Use the button above to open your browser's extension management page.
Browser.Step2: Turn on Developer mode, then choose Load unpacked.
Browser.Step3: Select the extension folder below and pin the extension to the toolbar.
Browser.Step4: Open a page that is playing audio and click the extension icon to enable that tab.
Browser.Step5: Return to the mixer to adjust volume, balance, EQ, and output device.
Browser.Step6: The first time you select a non-default output, listen and confirm it on the browser authorization page.
Browser.PrivacyDescription: The extension does not record, save, or upload audio or page content. Opening the browser does not start the desktop application; only clicking the extension icon processes the current tab.
Browser.NeverPromptAutomation: Do not automatically prompt for browser setup again
Dynamic.BrowserEqUnavailable: The extension can still control volume and output, but effects are unavailable. Reload the current extension version.
Dynamic.BrowserProtocolOld: The extension is using legacy protocol 1. Reload the current version to enable 200% gain and output selection.
